lead.event: The rupiah hits record lows as officials explain and respond to the decline
lead.headline: BI intervenes as rupiah hits record lows after 1.15% monthly decline
lead.blurb: The rupiah closed at a reported record-low Rp18,184 per US dollar on 28 October, after weakening 1.15% over the month. BI said it supported the currency through spot, NDF and DNDF transactions and bought government bonds in the secondary market, and would coordinate with corporations and market participants. BI attributed the pressure to Middle East uncertainty, rising expectations of US rate hikes, emerging-market outflows and higher month-end foreign-exchange demand.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The rupiah closed at a reported record-low level of Rp18,184 per US dollar on 28 October 2026.

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia relaxes reserve requirements for banks
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts banks’ reserve requirements by 2 percentage points
market_structure_policy.blurb: The changes begin on 1 November: conventional banks’ requirement falls from 9% to 7%, while Islamic banks’ and units’ rate drops from 7.5% to 6.5%, then to 5.5% on 1 December. BTN CEO Nixon L.P. Napitupulu estimates the 2% cut could add Rp6 trillion to Rp8 trillion in liquidity for lending.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia Stock Exchange advances demutualization and considers Danantara’s share offer
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia's exchange advances demutualization with Rp1.56 trillion dividend
market_structure_policy.blurb: BEI approved the plan at its 28 October meeting, setting a special dividend of Rp17 million per share for shareholders recorded on 27 October. Danantara has offered to become a shareholder and is undergoing due diligence, while the mechanism, valuation and timeline remain subject to shareholder approval.

macro_flows.event: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below target
macro_flows.headline: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below Rp30 trillion target
macro_flows.blurb: At the 27 October auction, incoming bids fell 52.05% to Rp31.09 trillion from Rp64.86 trillion on 13 October. The government accepted higher yields, with FR0110 at 7.38%, FR0111 at 7.55% and FR0112 at 7.5%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BRI will run the phase from 22 October to 21 January 2027, following a first phase of up to Rp500 billion from 12 June to 11 September 2026. Shareholders approved buybacks of up to Rp3 trillion on 24 March 2025.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Mandiri extends a credit facility to Jhonlin Baratama
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMRI extends Jhonlin Baratama a Rp40 trillion credit facility
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama had utilized Rp17 trillion as of 26 October, and the facility supports capital expenditure, business development and financing needs in coal and supporting sectors. Repayment is expected from Jhonlin Group operations and subsidiary dividends.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TBS Energi Utama secures HPS Investment Partners funding
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA secures SGD555 million in HPS funding
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: TBS Energi Utama is focusing on an integrated regional waste-management model rather than Danantara's PSEL projects in Indonesia. HPS Investment Partners, part of BlackRock, will invest gradually through new preferred shares in subsidiary SBTH Asia Holdings and other instruments to fund organic growth and acquisitions.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia plans a Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS plans Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia plans to run the repurchase from 27 October to 26 January 2027, which President Director Anggoro Eko Cahyo says reflects management’s view that its shares are undervalued. It will seek approval on 6 November for a 6.8 billion-share rights issue to meet the 15% free-float requirement.

deals_control.event: Energi Mega Persada targets completing its HighPeak Energy investment
deals_control.headline: ENRG targets completing US$200 million HighPeak investment by year-end
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada is making the investment through newly issued convertible preferred shares in HighPeak Energy, which can convert into common shares under agreed mechanisms. The transaction is expected to close before the end of 2026.

other.event: Indonesia Stock Exchange approves its first special dividend
other.headline: Indonesia Stock Exchange approves first Rp1.56 trillion special dividend
other.blurb: Shareholders of record on 27 October are entitled to the payout, based on audited financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026. They also approved allocating Rp2 trillion of retained earnings for operational needs and company development.

earnings_guidance.event: BCA reports nine-month results and raises its 2026 loan-growth outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA raises 2026 loan-growth outlook to 10-12%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BCA reported nine-month net profit of Rp45.2 trillion, up 4.2% year on year, as loans reached Rp1,063 trillion, up 12.6%. It has not formally revised its initial 8-10% Business Plan target and does not plan an RBB revision. BCA expects net interest margin to remain near its Q3 2026 level.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises its upside view on BCA shares
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises BBCA upside view to as much as 63%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas says BCA shares have up to 63% upside, citing strengthening loan growth and net interest margin recovery. BCA's loans grew 12% year on year to Rp1,062 trillion, and management raised its 2026 loan growth guidance to 10%-11% from 8%-10%.

earnings_guidance.event: Astra International reports nine-month financial results

earnings_guidance.blurb: Excluding non-recurring items, net profit was Rp24.6 trillion, broadly stable year on year, while earnings per share rose 1% to Rp616. Net revenue increased 0.10% to Rp243.9 trillion, but net other items swung from Rp1.84 trillion in income to Rp2.43 trillion in expense.

earnings_guidance.event: Maha Properti reports third-quarter loss and widening cumulative deficit

earnings_guidance.blurb: Maha Properti's revenue rose 44.62% to Rp3.63 billion, while cost of goods sold and direct expenses increased to Rp2.53 billion. Its loss narrowed from Rp54.89 billion in the same period last year.
